_comment: Thresholds for the nine deterministic risk-gate rules. Every value here is read at runtime by options_agent/nodes/risk_gate.py — no threshold is ever hard-coded in the checking logic. Tune these without touching code.

delta.rationale: Rule 1. ~20% probability of finishing ITM, so ~80% of spreads expire worthless. Keeps the short strike well away from at-the-money.

notional.rationale: Rule 2. Worst-case loss on any single position capped at 2% of net liquidation value. A full loss is recoverable; three in a row is still survivable.

portfolio.rationale: Rule 3. Net delta-dollars across all open positions capped at 50% of NAV: the book is never more directionally exposed than being half long the index. RECALIBRATED from plan.md's 0.10. A single 15-delta bull put spread sized to the 2% loss budget carries roughly $32k of delta-dollars on a $100k account, so a 0.10 cap ($10k) rejects every trade the rest of the strategy is designed to produce. 0.50 still binds - it caps the book at about two concurrent max-size positions - while letting the agent actually trade. Lower it to tighten; the gate sizes positions down to fit rather than rejecting outright.

premium.rationale: Rule 4. Below $25 per contract the credit does not compensate for bid/ask slippage and commission. Also filters out illiquid strikes.

duplicate.rationale: Rule 5. Never stack a second position on a strike already held. Prevents silent over-concentration across cycles.

dte.rationale: Rules 6 and 7. Under 7 days gamma dominates and a small spot move swings P&L violently. Over 14 days theta decay is too slow to be worth the capital.

daily_loss.rationale: Rule 8. If the book is down more than 5% on the day, stop opening anything. Circuit breaker against compounding a bad day.

buying_power.rationale: Rule 9. Always keep 20% of starting buying power unused, so positions moving against us cannot trigger a margin call.
